text:
rachel: Opening PR to refresh the Quickstart: add a minimal Kotlin example, clarify auth env var naming, and a tiny Windows dev note for PowerShell users. PR: http://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/4333. Asking for devex + eng-runtime review.

docs-bot: PR #4333 opened by rachel  CI queued.

mike: Nice. For Kotlin, show a single blocking OkHttp example and a short comment about coroutine variants. Keep it copy-paste friendly.

juan: Also please normalize the env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY (we had mixed usage in a couple of pages). Add a one-liner for PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<token>"`. That will help Windows users.

rachel: Pushed initial commit with curl, Kotlin (OkHttp), and PowerShell examples. Example Kotlin:```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient()
val req = Request.Builder()
  .url(System.getenv("REDWOOD_ENDPOINT") + "/v1/generate")
  .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
  .post(RequestBody.create(MediaType.parse("application/json"), "{\"input\":\"hi\"}"))
  .build()
val resp = client.newCall(req).execute()
println(resp.body()?.string())
```

docs-bot: markdown-lint flagged a missing code-fence language on one block.

mike: Also note: SDK JS rename changed import path last month; docs referencing `@redwood/sdk` should be updated elsewhere but not necessary in this PR. Left a comment.

rachel: Fixed code fence languages and updated the auth section to recommend Secrets Manager for production. Added a tiny "Windows note": "PowerShell: set $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY before running the starter app; avoid checking .env.ps1 into repos."

windows-bot: Reminder: on Windows, some CI runners need CRLF-safe scripts; added a link to the internal devex guide.

preview-bot: Staging preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4333  check Kotlin snippet and PowerShell phrasing.

juan: Approved after small nit fixes. Please ensure the placeholder REDWOOD_ENDPOINT is used (no concrete hostnames).

mike: LGTM for the Kotlin snippet. I left a tiny formatting nit (line wrap) which rachel fixed.

rachel: Thanks! Merging once CI passes. Will open a follow-up issue to sweep other language pages for REDWOOD_API_KEY consistency.
